observations.why: Imperative directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, a rank-based allocation of what the recipient may hold.
Second imperative command reinforces authority-ranking: speaker directs the recipient to strip knowledge, performing hierarchical control over what is known.

mints.name: DirectiveKnowledgeErasure
mints.title: Forget everything about… Remove all knowledge of…
mints.frame: Is the speaker performing hierarchical control by commanding what the recipient must forget or purge from memory?
